changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sbsr_resp ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, response_file VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, orgnl_msg_id VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL, e2e VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, reason VARCHAR(8), version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (response_file, e2e) );
